title: Build Your First Useful n8n Business Workflow
summary: See how a repeatable business task becomes an automation with a trigger, clean inputs, safeguards and a clear result.
directory_line: Go from a manual task to a workflow you can explain and test.
description: Visual preview only. This is an illustrative free introductory webinar, not a scheduled class.
audience: Professionals curious about n8n and practical business automation
leave_with: A simple working workflow design with trigger, action and error path.
A checklist to decide what tasks should not be automated.
A clear explanation of what the workflow saves and what it costs to maintain.
